name: Hotel Le Negresco
positioning: Independent hotel on the Promenade des Anglais in Nice since 1913, with art-filled rooms, an art-themed spa and a seasonal beach club
best_for: Travelers who want a historic seafront base on the Promenade des Anglais
Spa lovers drawn to an art-themed spa with a pool, hammams and immersive yoga
Couples or friends wanting a private spa suite

facts.text: Le Negresco has stood on the Promenade des Anglais in Nice since 1913.
Le Negresco is an independent hotel.
Rooms and suites are furnished with pieces ranging from antiques to contemporary creations, each inspired by distant lands and remarkable periods of history.
The Signature Collection includes named suites such as the Marie-Antoinette Suite and the Montserrat Caballé Suite.
La Rotonde is a contemporary brasserie.
Le Versailles is a champagne bar with a terrace; on summer evenings it offers cocktails, sharing plates and live music.
The spa's wet area has saunas, hammams and sensory showers.
L'Ecrin is a private spa suite suited to couples or friends.
Fitness sessions with expert coaches can be held indoors or outside facing the sea.
The garden at N La Plage, the hotel's beach club, was created by landscape designer Hervé Frezal, a Meilleur Ouvrier de France, with native Mediterranean plants such as jasmine, fig and palm.
Event venues include the Salon Royal, the Salon Masséna, the Salon Louis XVI and the Baie des Anges Salon.

highlights.text: The spa pool is bathed in natural light and has underwater music.
Rooms and suites combine period furnishings with modern amenities and look out over the Baie des Anges or the Masséna garden.
Le 1913 is the hotel's historic bar, evoking English clubs, with amber-toned panelling, artworks and bespoke cocktails.
The spa offers immersive yoga sessions where digital art merges with sound and movement.
The spa's Concept Store has a laboratory that creates a bespoke serum on the spot.

considerations.text: N La Plage, the hotel's beach club, is open daily only from May to September.
Rooms and suites look out over either the Baie des Anges or the Masséna garden.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's exclusive positioning.

sources.title: Le Negresco: 5-star luxury hotel on the French Riviera
